version_scope: Fixed source references, not a claim about every installed torch_npu binary.

sources.claim: Ordinary CUDA replay reuses task parameters and pointer addresses; data at those addresses can change.
NPU replay delegates to the captured graph execution entry.
NPU C++ replay submits AclmdlRIExecuteAsync on the current stream.
copy_ copies source data into the destination tensor.
set_ can replace the underlying storage, size and strides.
record_stream concerns allocation reuse after already queued work, not automatic future replay ownership.
NPU graph update requires auto_dispatch_capture and uses registered update handlers.
Official source test demonstrates actual_seq_lengths update; this upstream test was read, not executed here.
SGLang retains captured graphs and output objects; replay preparation writes static inputs.
NPU EPLB constructs writable aliases of existing expert storage.

../../examples/graph-capture-tensor-stor.meaning: Runnable small device examples with expected-value assertions; no fabricated device log.

diagram.kind: Original explanatory diagram, not profiler output.
